invariants: Precedence is determined first by major, then minor, then patch, compared numerically
A version with a prerelease has lower precedence than the same version without one
Prerelease identifiers are compared left to right: numeric identifiers compare numerically, alphanumeric identifiers compare lexically in ASCII order
A numeric prerelease identifier always has lower precedence than an alphanumeric one
A prerelease with fewer identifiers has lower precedence than one with more, when all preceding identifiers are equal
Build metadata (after '+') is ignored for precedence
compareSemver(a, b) === -compareSemver(b, a) for all valid inputs
compareSemver(a, a) === 0 for all valid inputs
constraints: JavaScript for Node.js, single file named semver.js
CommonJS module exporting compareSemver as a named property of module.exports
Pure function, no I/O, no dependencies
Inputs are always valid semver strings; no validation required

examples.note: numeric identifier is lower than alphanumeric
numeric prerelease identifiers compare numerically, so 2 < 11

edgeCaseHints: Multi-digit numeric identifiers in prerelease (beta.2 vs beta.11)
Mixed numeric and alphanumeric prerelease identifiers
Build metadata on versions with and without prerelease
